Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 11
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly extracted the birth year for Ramsay Anderson in Step 11. The WebSurfer results clearly showed David Ramsay Anderson was born on **2 May 1888**. However, the Planner wrote "Ramsay Anderson: born 2 May **1988**" in the "Updated Understanding" section. This introduced a false year (1988 instead of 1888), which led the subsequent logic to incorrectly conclude that Fernand Fédronic (1964) was born before Ramsay Anderson. In reality, Ramsay Anderson (1888) was born first.
